description: Long-form body renderer (headings, paragraphs, lists, blockquote, image, table, inline/block code). Backs blog-post and case-study article bodies via src/components/longform/RichText.jsx + placeholderArticle.js. CONTENT POLICY: the body content this component renders is ALWAYS generated placeholder text, never measured-real copy — see sections/content-article-body.json for the full compliance note.

contentPolicy.rule: Deterministic per seed (string hash), so pages differ from each other but never change between loads. AI generation for this field MAY produce new neutral outbound-sales filler text; it must never attempt to reproduce Valley's real, unrecorded article bodies.
